title: Life Around Us · Q2 W03 D03
objective: Classify familiar examples as living or non-living and describe basic needs or body parts.

items.explanation: A cat grows, eats, drinks, and responds, so it is living. A rock, water, and a pencil do not grow.

items.prompt: Which is NOT a living thing?
items.explanation: A spoon does not grow and does not need food or water, so it is not living. The duck, the cat, and the banana plant are living.

items.prompt: What do all living things need to grow?
items.explanation: Living things need food and water to grow and stay alive. Shelves, batteries, and covers are not food or water.

items.prompt: Which part makes food for the plant?
items.explanation: Leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant. Fur, wheels, and roots do not make food.

items.prompt: Which example shows a living thing?
items.explanation: A banana plant grows, needs water, and makes food in its leaves, so it is living. A spoon, water, and a pencil are not.
